description: Gevoelige bestemmingen Externe veiligheid buisleidingen is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by download.geodata-utrecht.nl. Place-based risk contours 10-6/year and focus areas due to pipelines for transport of hazardous substances have been translated into GES (Health Impact Screening) contours. The sensitive destinations in the various GES contours have been mapped. The aim is to understand bottlenecks in the existing situation and the risks involved in new developments. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Sensitive destinations External safety pipes" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2025-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
